root_idea.summary: An underlying idea of opening or expansion, especially the opening of the mouth; hence the mouth, utterance, and openings such as the mouth of a river.
root_idea.development: The root develops from physical opening and breadth to speaking or emitting words, to openings or foremost entrances of places. The designation of perfume and aromatics is explained through the idea of fragrance as if it were speaking or issuing forth.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural is normalized to the classical singular citation form فُوهٌ.
فَاهُ is an inflected form of the same mouth noun represented by the normalized headword فُوهٌ.

senses.definition: Mouth; the bodily organ of speech.
senses.usage_conditions: The form occurs in both plural and singular inflected usage. It may denote the mouth in a literal bodily action or situation.

senses.definition: An outward spoken claim or profession issuing from the mouth, especially one that does not correspond to the heart; hence, in the relevant Quranic constructions, an indication of falsehood or insincerity.
senses.usage_conditions: This figurative sense is specific to constructions that attach speech or profession to the mouth while contrasting it with inward belief or the heart; it does not apply to every literal occurrence of mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter or pronounce a saying; to mention or give voice to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِهِ for the saying or matter uttered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have a wide or large mouth; also, to have protruding or elongated teeth, especially the upper central incisors.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to width of the mouth, protrusion of the teeth from the lips, or the length of the teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone wide-mouthed or broad in the mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the person made أَفْوَه, or wide-mouthed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have eaten much of a food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is preserved as a reported passive reading of a cited expression; the source itself corrects the transmitted active vocalization toward the passive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To talk or discourse with someone; also, to contend with him for superiority in glory or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb expresses reciprocal conversation or, in another construction, verbal contest for distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the ordinary intransitive verbal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter the mouth or opening of a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of entering the opening of a place, by analogy with the mouth as the first entrance to an interior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To talk or converse with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat or drink vehemently or copiously; to eat much, and to quench one's thirst by drinking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may especially describe eating or drinking after scarcity or weakness, though the broader sense of eating much is also attested; drinking is less frequent in the evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mouth of one person near the mouth of another, in an expression describing face-to-face proximity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In كَلَّمْتُهُ فَاهُ إِلَى فِيَّ, the phrase following the verb expresses the speaker's state or the close positioning of the two mouths.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An imprecation wishing that misfortune, disappointment, or the ground cleave to someone's mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed proverbial expression; the mouth may be used metonymically for the teeth or for the dust of the earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In expressions concerning camels, watering them as they come to drink, or allowing them to graze while moving along.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the constructions عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهَا and جَرَّ إِبِلَهُ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The nearest or shortest way to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed idiomatic expression meaning the nearest route or means of access.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An appellation for one whose breath smells foul.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nickname or descriptive expression, literally referring to the mouth of a horse suffering from foul-smelling indigestion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A nickname applied to a little man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are fixed appellations, literally framed as the mouth of a field rat or of a small wingless locust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The teeth or front teeth, by metonymic use of mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in expressions about teeth not being broken or falling out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The face, especially in expressions of falling or being prostrated face-down; also to die or be caused to die prostrate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The mouth term is used metonymically for the face, with لِ functioning in the sense of عَلَى in the cited expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Perfume or an odoriferous substance; also an aromatic, spice, flower, or other ingredient used to compound fragrance, and by extension kinds or mixtures of such substances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural أَفْوَاهُ الطِّيبِ is especially used for aromatics, spices, and fragrant flowers; one lexical qualification excludes things called عَقَّارٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A red-rooted dye plant, identified in the evidence with madder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The identification is reported as a specialized lexical usage and is distinguished from the ordinary mouth noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mouth or opening of a river, valley, watercourse, street, or road; the foremost or entrance part of a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Depending on the object, it can denote the inlet, outlet, head, foremost portion, or place of egress; the basic comparison is with a mouth as an entrance to an interior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A say, saying, or speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is used in expressions concerning what has been said or the speech of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Evil speech or backbiting that damages another person's reputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for speech that rends or harms reputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strength, freedom, or uninhibited force in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person who is powerful or unconstrained in expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehement eating by a camel or horse; good eating that reveals the animal's fatness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing an animal's vigorous feeding and the inference of good condition drawn from it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk retaining a sweet taste.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized food-related usage; a variant with ق is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who discloses everything in his mind; one who openly reveals his hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term describes openness or indiscretion in revealing what is inward, including hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide-mouthed, with a broad opening; by extension, wide in a well or wound, or broad in a pulley-sheave with long teeth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The masculine and feminine forms are applied to people and horses; the extended uses include a wide-mouthed well, a wide wound, and a wide sheave whose teeth are long.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eloquent or able in speech; a good and effective speaker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or of speech, as in مِنْطِيقٌ مُفَوَّهٌ and مَنْطِقٌ مُفَوَّهٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vehement or excessive eater; one with an inordinate appetite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man or to another creature; the evidence also relates it to eating vehemently after scarcity or weakness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Perfumed or flavored with aromatic substances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a beverage or wine prepared with the aromatics called أَفَاوِيهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dyed with madder or the related red dye plant فُوَّه.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a garment or piece of cloth.

The speech-related Quranic sense is construction-sensitive: it concerns outward speech or profession contrasted with inward belief, not every occurrence of the anatomical mouth.
